modules.title: Agent 反复失败时，Harness 到底补什么
三个案例分别解决了什么问题

items.title: 页面能显示但不能操作
items.text: 独立评审器用浏览器实际点击、截图并检查完整流程。失败动作和具体批评会回到下一轮，而不是让生成页面的 Agent 自己给自己打分。

items.title: 换一轮就重复旧工作
items.text: 功能清单、进度文件、启动脚本和 Git 提交把状态留在项目里。下一轮先读记录并跑基础检查，再选择一个未完成项继续。

items.title: 代码逐渐违反原有规则
items.text: 简短项目地图帮助 Agent 找入口，结构化文档提供细节，自定义 lint 和结构测试把架构要求变成会失败的规则，并指出修正路径。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Agent 循环负责一次运行何时继续、暂停或停止；Harness Engineering 改造的是循环所在的环境。它不能保证模型永不犯错，但能让重复错误更早暴露、被保存成证据，并在下一轮得到纠正。装上一个 SDK 或写一份很长的说明，都不等于已经有可靠的 Harness。

lessonPractice.title: 前端 Agent 连续三次交付“看起来完成”的页面，但点击主按钮都没有反应。哪种改法最像 Harness Engineering？

options.label: 让独立评审器用浏览器完成主流程，把失败步骤和截图送回下一轮，通过后才结束
options.feedback: 对。这里补的是会实际操作页面、产生失败证据并把证据送回下一轮的评测环境。

options.label: 只让 Agent 多截几张静态图，图看起来完整就算通过
options.feedback: 静态图只能证明页面能显示，不能证明按钮、导航和完整任务真的可用。

options.label: 把提示词改成“请认真检查所有交互”，仍由 Agent 自己判断是否完成
options.feedback: 自我提醒没有增加新的证据来源，同一种遗漏仍可能被带到下一轮。

en.title: A frontend agent delivers a page that “looks done” three times, but the main button never works. Which change is harness engineering?

options.label: Have an independent evaluator complete the live flow, return failed steps and screenshots, and end only after it passes
options.feedback: Correct. This adds an environment that operates the page, produces failure evidence, and returns it to the next turn.

options.label: Only ask for more static screenshots and pass the page whenever they look complete
options.feedback: A static image proves that the page renders, not that its buttons, navigation, or end-to-end task work.

options.label: Add “carefully check every interaction” while still letting the agent judge its own work
options.feedback: A reminder adds no new source of evidence, so the same omission can survive another turn.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 先不要直接重做功能。请把最近一次重复失败写成“可观察证据 → 缺少的环境支持 → 要补的文件、工具或检查 → 结果怎样回到下一轮 → 什么才算通过”。先给我一个最小 Harness 方案，再按方案修改并用真实结果验收。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Do not rebuild the feature yet. Describe the repeated failure as: observable evidence → missing environmental support → file, tool, or check to add → how the result returns to the next turn → what counts as passing. Propose the smallest harness first, then implement it and verify it with real evidence.

learning.assumes: You know an AI agent can read files, call tools, and work through multiple steps.
learning.outcome: When an agent repeats a failure, you can identify missing discoverable knowledge, recoverable progress, executable constraints, or outcome-based checks.

modules.title: What a harness adds when an agent keeps failing

items.title: The frontend renders but does not work
items.text: An independent evaluator operates the live page, captures screenshots, and checks the complete flow. Failed actions and specific critique return to the next turn instead of letting the generator grade itself.

items.title: A long task forgets between sessions
items.text: A feature list, progress file, startup script, and Git commits keep state in the project. The next session reads them, runs a basic check, and continues one unfinished item.

items.title: A large repository drifts
items.text: A short project map provides the entry point, structured docs hold the details, and custom lint and structural tests turn architecture rules into failures with a remediation path.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: An agent loop controls when one run continues, pauses, or stops; harness engineering changes the environment around that loop. It cannot guarantee that a model never fails, but it can expose recurring errors earlier, preserve evidence, and feed corrections into the next turn. Installing an SDK or writing a long instruction file does not create a reliable harness by itself.
